_notes: Microsoft Entra ID, single tenant. Always use the tenant-specific v2.0 issuer (never /common or /organizations).
Register the redirect URI under the 'Single-page application' platform; Entra accepts http:// only for localhost,
so use TLS mode (https://angular.127.0.0.1.nip.io/callback) or 'npm start' on http://localhost:4200/callback.
The API scope api://<API_CLIENT_ID>/access_as_user makes the access token's aud = <API_CLIENT_ID>;
without it Entra issues a Microsoft Graph token that the APIs cannot validate.
Entra's discovery endpoints do not start with the issuer URL -> strictDiscoveryDocumentValidation must be false.
App roles assigned on the API registration appear in the access token as 'roles'.
